rows.label: tlk70000075_05_msg001
rows.name:
The Special Commissioner will make a
move not long after you all depart.

rows.label: tlk70000075_05_msg002
rows.name:
Kagutsuchi-sama and Wadatsumi-sama
are treasures of Superbia. We can't let
anything happen to them...

rows.label: tlk70000075_05_msg004
rows.name:
I am sorry that I am unable to protect
Your Majesty directly at this crucial
time, after all you have done for me.

rows.label: tlk70000075_05_msg005
rows.name:
But both the Special Commissioner and
I... this expedition ending without
incident, and...

rows.label: tlk70000075_05_msg006
rows.name:
That great achievements can be brought
home—I sincerely believe it!
